desc: Derive the per-element contribution formula: cost = c_i*i - c_i*(c_i+1)/2 with c_i = #{j<i : P_j > P_i}; matches Samples 1-3 and hand-checked cases.
Implement O(N log N) Fenwick-tree scan (c_i = seen count minus #seen <= P_i), accumulate c_i*i - c_i*(c_i+1)//2; passed all 3 public samples.

Confirm optimality/lower bound: each swap is the unique leftward crossing of the smaller element; doing a element's c crossings consecutively at positions i-1,…,i-c is both forced-minimal and achievable by left-bubbling in original position order (verified across many cases, incl. trickier [2,4,3,1]→8, [1,4,3,2]→7, [2,3,4,1]→6).
Confirm direction/order matters (right-pushing greedy overcounts, e.g. 5 vs 4 on [3,2,1]); left-insertion is correct.
Ensure 1-based positions, correct off-by-one in c_i arithmetic, and arbitrary-precision (no overflow; worst case ~2.7e15).
